items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was sitting out front with Herman Leonard and Woody Herman.

ctx.x: The night his brother got stabbed to death. I was sitting out front with Herman Leonard and Woody Herman. We got out early after the police came in to question everyone. But that was a night. Ernestine Anderson was singing. I had replaced her in the Hamp band. I knew she was a very emotional creature. I knew that this must have just shocked her to death. So I went backstage. She was in a terrible state. Morris’s brother was dying on the floor. It was a horrible night.
Do you remember what precipitated this incident?
